title: CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY LAW
description: Practical focus upon legal concepts applicable to the construction industry. Provides sufficient understanding to manage legal aspects, instead of being managed by them. Topics include contractual relationships, contract performance, contract flexibility and change orders, liability and negligence, dispute avoidance/resolution, surety bonds, insurance and site safety
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Graduate standing or the instructor's permission.
raw_title_text: CIEN E4134 CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY LAW. 3.00 points .
